en_us.item.beta.name: Beta Features
en_us.item.glitch.name: Glitch
en_us.item.glitch.message.1: Prometheus was punished by the gods by giving the gift of knowledge to man. He was cast into the bowels of the earth and pecked by birds.
en_us.item.glitch.message.8: Oh, and by the way: The polaroid shifts reality. Things can be different if the polaroid is broken.
en_us.item.glitch.message.13: Have some free stuff. You'll need it for that one cryptic achievement.
en_us.item.glitch.message.17: 89% of magic tricks are not magic. Technically, they are sorcery.
en_us.item.glitch.message.22: Budget cuts, no effect for you.
en_us.item.glitch.message.25: More devastating than a falling boxcar!
en_us.item.glitch.message.30: It's dangerous to go alone, take this!
en_us.item.glitch.fate.18: BANG! Choo-chooo! B A N G ! ! !

zh_cn.item.beta.name: Beta测试版功能
zh_cn.item.glitch.name: 故障
zh_cn.item.glitch.message.1: 普罗米修斯因将知识的礼物赠予人类而遭到众神惩罚。他被投入地底，任鸟啄食。
zh_cn.item.glitch.message.8: 顺便说一句：偏光片会改变现实。偏光片损坏后，事情可能就不一样了。
zh_cn.item.glitch.message.13: 送你一些免费的东西。那个晦涩难懂的成就会用得上。
zh_cn.item.glitch.message.17: 89%的魔术并不是魔法。严格来说，它们是巫术。
zh_cn.item.glitch.message.22: 预算削减，这次没有效果。
zh_cn.item.glitch.message.25: 比从天而降的箱车还具破坏力！
zh_cn.item.glitch.message.30: 独自前行太危险了，拿上这个！
zh_cn.item.glitch.fate.18: BANG! Choo-chooo! B A N G ! ! !
